title: The overlays have a way in
question: You said the overlays looked better but that the main issue was there was no key or menu row to turn them on. There is now: O cycles the ground overlay, and all three sit in OPTIONS. Is that the way in you wanted, and is O the right key?
context_md:
**`O` is the evolution lab's own key for this**, so the reflex carries between the two games. The lab's other two overlay keys were not free here — `L` is the held look and `H` holds the world, both core verbs — so rather than pick two arbitrary letters, those two are menu rows only. That follows the lab's own reasoning: the ground overlay *earned* the key because it is where the pheromones are, which in this game is what `G` writes into.

**One honest gap.** The channel that matters most here is her own scent trail, and I could not get a still of it: the screenshot hook counts drawn frames while the walk counts player ticks, so the shutter fired after she had walked four cells and the overlay drew an empty plane. Rather than post a picture of nothing and call it a trail, the arm below is temperature, which paints every cell and proves the channel reaches the screen. The scent one wants a GIF, next time.
